name: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd
title: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd - 544256 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 gross margin fell to 9.7% as bars and coins hit 40% of sales (vs 28%), yet management held FY27 guidance of INR13,500 crore revenue, 7-7.5% EBITDA and 4% PAT with no numeric update on the margin.

triggers.label: Q4 gross margin 9.7% on bars and coins
triggers.quote: Gross margin stood at 9.7%. The moderation in Q4 FY26 was primarily driven by higher share of gold bars and coins

triggers.label: Bars and coins 40% of Q4 sales
triggers.quote: The share of gold bars and coin sales in the overall revenue mix rose 28% in Q4 FY25 to 40% in Q4 FY26.
triggers.highlight: rose 28% in Q4 FY25 to 40% in Q4 FY26

triggers.label: Hedging 57% → 63% → 67%
triggers.quote: we are covered for 1,300 kg of gold on the hedging through various GMLs and MCX and other instruments. So this is 67%.

guidance.quote: EBITDA margin of 7% to 7.5% and a PAT margin of 4% for FY27.
a PAT margin of 4% for FY27.
So next year we should be at 75% to 80%.

guidance.metric: Bars and coins share of sales FY27
guidance.quote: we should be at around 25% for this financial year.
1.5 is what we would stick to or in fact we would try to go a little lower

prior_guidance_check.quote: we had guided for a INR9,500 crores top line. We crossed that by a INR1,000 crores and we were at INR10,700.

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 EBITDA margin in line with guidance
prior_guidance_check.quote: EBITDA margin improving by 180 bps to 6.6%, which is in line with our earlier guidance as well.
gross margin expanding by 280 bps to 12% on a yearly level

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY27 revenue INR12,000 crore earlier guidance
prior_guidance_check.quote: we feel that INR12,500 can be stretched to INR13,500, and that's where the guidance is coming from.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin explained as one-time; franchise mix rising
red_flags.quote: We therefore view the gross margin impact as largely one-time and mix-driven, not structural

red_flags.label: Working capital tied in hedging margins
red_flags.quote: There was a cash burden on from that point of view if we will lock these margins, this was very expensive

red_flags.label: Inventory turns falling
red_flags.quote: The impact of new stores which we opened in H2 is the primary driver of this coming down

evasions.quote: So, these three together have been have been able to we have been able to demonstrate why there was a dip in margins in Q4
Net volumes, which include jewellery and bullion, exactly to quantify right now is difficult
We haven't really thought on, you know, going ahead on that front at this point of time.
